name: SOLO
description:
## Description

"A speaker system designed by Phil Jones.A 9cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.In this unit, the rigidity is improved by pressing three ribs on the concentric circle of the diaphragm, and the piston motion stroke of 26mm is realized with low distortion.The voice coil uses OCC copper wire with a purity of 99.9999%.A 2.5cm metal dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The tweeter unit is equipped with a unique diffuser that greatly improves phase characteristics and directional characteristics, and a high heat radiation effect is obtained by filling the gap with magnetic fluid.The voice coil uses OCC copper wire with a purity of 99.9999%, similar to the woofer.The acoustic filter characteristic of the network section is 30dB/36dB.In addition to the use of carefully selected parts, heat generated by the network is drained from the rear heat sink.The enclosure incorporates 26mm thick high-density fiberboard and 6mm thick integrally molded die-cast rear baffles and top / bottom plates for excellent rigidity and damping.The sound is tuned with the front grill attached, and the grill is non-detachable.Also, there are 2types of exterior, rosewood finish and wood grain black finish.It is equipped with an extremely thick bolt mounting seat at the lower part of the body, and you can surely set the leg of 3point support which is standard equipment and the stand sold separately."

name: REFERENCE1
description:
## Description

"This bookshelf type speaker system was announced as a super tuned model based on the basic design of the Platinum Solo.It is equipped with a 9cm metal cone type woofer in the low range and a 2.5cm metal dome type tweeter in the high range.These units are designed for the Solo/Duo and are selectively used within ¥0.5dB of the characteristic deviation so that the total frequency characteristic is kept within ¥1dB.The network section uses metalized PP capacitors and other high-quality parts. In particular, the coil uses an air-core type with a special structure in which a wide copper foil is wound in the form of a tape. This coil has frequency-reactance characteristics that are very close to those of an ideal inductor. In addition, there is no degradation of high-frequency linearity due to the skin effect, making it possible to minimize electrical loss and compression.In addition, the heat generated by the resistance element is discharged from the heat sink installed on the back of the network to suppress the temperature rise of the network.The enclosure uses a new material, Abonite Solid.With a specific gravity approximately 2.6times that of MDF, Abonite Solid has a texture and feel similar to that of marble. Moreover, it is homogeneous and stable unlike natural materials. This material is used in a 2-ply (26mm thick) and is assembled into a tough box structure.In addition, by adopting die-cast rear baffle and top / bottom plate, excellent rigidity and damping effect are realized.The exterior is polished to make use of the texture of Abonite.The sound is tuned with the front grill attached, and the grill is non-detachable."
